self_weight.method: Distributed beam/node weights scaled to exact CAD mass; connector couple corrects total CAD gravitational moment. Local body-force distribution remains idealized.

assumptions: Linear isotropic resin with assumed effective E.
Beam–ball interfaces are rigid in the global frame; local 3D submodels are one-way, not a coupled contact solution.
Nominal beam section envelopes exclude bevel, socket, screws, adhesion, creep and failure.
Short connector members violate slender-beam assumptions; phi is reported for every member.
Self-weight force and moment match full CAD, while their spatial reduction to a frame is approximate.
